correctness.rationale: For independent equal-scale Mittag–Leffler waiting times of indices α,β∈(0,1), the even normalized log-rate exponential-mixture densities make P(D<R)=1/2 by symmetry of the rate difference. The embedded jump/reset mark law (1/4,1/4,1/2) gives the killed-walk root r=2−√3, finite E N=2(1+√3) and a 2-step success probability 1/8, hence exponential N tail. Conditional on each finite mark/sign path, event durations remain independent with type-dependent regularly varying index δ=α+β and tail constants αC/δ, βC/δ; a polynomial-in-N bound and its geometric tail justify dominated stopped-sum asymptotics. This yields P(T>t)~2(1+√3)t^(−δ)/(Γ(1−α)Γ(1−β)), delay-type fractions α/δ and β/δ, the exact Laplace recurrence and E T=E N E[min(D,R)] finite exactly when δ>1. This concerns renewed clocks at each event and a discrete +1 target only.
residual_risks: The stopped-sum dominated-convergence step depends on the asserted uniform regularly varying type-tail bound, not on a numerical test.
